title: Browser window
description: Your screenshot inside a plain browser window that fills the frame. The page scrolls slowly, a cursor travels in and clicks, and the page answers by scrolling on. The address bar shows only the text you give it. A caption can sit under the window.

props.label: text in the address bar (optional; empty if you give none)
props.at: [x, y] where the cursor clicks, in % of the page area ([60, 60])
props.scroll: how far the page travels, share of its height (0.24)
props.page: true: a long page screenshot, shown at full width and scrolled
props.color: colour of the click mark and the small caps
